verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party way to version, review, or roll back automations. Conversation checkpointing (gh-8) saves and resumes chat sessions, which is a different feature from versioning or rolling back automation definitions. Running non-interactively in scripts (gh-6) leaves versioning to the user's own tooling, which is a workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
